blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of fresh V131 front and side views shows the sharp skirt-to-waist ledge persists despite the prior 60 mm height blend.
Reducing to one 36 mm fold per panel did not produce legible alternating valleys; front and three-quarter views still read as a smooth triangular flare.
Fresh V131 crouch and sit views show the skirt crossing the thighs; prone folds into a broad smooth mass without separated panels.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
